subject: FultonRail AP: vendor enrollment, PO/invoice mapping & VAT handling
messages:
From: Jorge Ruiz <jorge.ruiz@fultonrail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor enrollment & PO flow questions for Redwood

Hi Irene,

Quick note from the FultonRail AP team — we're getting Redwood set up in our supplier system and I ran into a couple of questions before we finish the profile. I've attached our vendor registration form (filled) for your records. Two items we need clarified from your side so our procurement team can issue POs cleanly: 

1) Legal entity and VAT/TIN for invoicing — we see multiple Redwood legal names in previous contracts. Which entity should we bill for the managed inference usage?
2) Do you accept a consolidated invoice for multiple POs (we sometimes split services across POs) or do you require one invoice per PO?

Other items: remit instructions (bank details), preferred invoice file format (PDF or e-invoice/UBL), and whether you support EDI/SFTP for invoice submission.

Goal: we want to cut the first PO next week. Can you send the missing details and any onboarding packet we should upload to our vendor portal?

Thanks,
Jorge
Jorge Ruiz
Senior AP Analyst — FultonRail Ltd
ap@fultonrail.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 11:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & PO flow questions for Redwood

Hi Jorge,

Thanks for sending the form — and welcome. I've attached our AP onboarding packet and a short PO mapping spec that should answer most of your portal fields. High level answers below, and I list next steps at the end.

Quick answers and requirements:
- Legal entity to bill: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) for hosted invoices. For customers requiring EU invoicing to an EU legal entity, we can invoice from Redwood Inference UK Ltd — please confirm which legal entity you need on the vendor profile.
- VAT/TIN: We will provide the VAT number once you confirm the entity. For intra-EU services where reverse-charge applies, we will not charge VAT on the invoice and will include the reverse-charge note and our VAT number.
- Invoice granularity: We can accept either (a) one invoice per PO or (b) consolidated invoices that reference multiple PO numbers. Preference: one invoice per PO is simplest for straight-through processing, but we can accept consolidated monthly invoices if you supply a comma-separated PO list in the invoice header.
- File formats accepted: PDF invoices by email or portal upload; we also support UBL/Peppol e-invoices and SFTP drop (CSV/CSV+PDF). EDI is supported on a limited pilot.
- Remit & bank: we'll provide bank remit details in the packet. If you need local bank in EU, let us know and we'll surface a local remit account if available.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.xlsx (vendor profile, bank remit template, required tax docs)
- PO_Mapping_Spec_20270203.pdf (how to map your PO fields to our invoice parser)

Action items / next steps:
1) Confirm which legal entity you want on the vendor profile (Redwood Inference, Inc. or Redwood Inference UK Ltd).
2) If you want consolidated invoices, confirm the frequency and whether AP will accept a single PDF with a master cover page listing POs.
3) Upload the onboarding packet to your portal and share the portal link or SFTP credentials for invoice submission testing.
4) We'll generate a DocuSign request for W-8/W-9 or equivalent tax form after you confirm the entity.

CCing Laura (billing ops) who will help with bank remit and PO-mapping testing.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Irene,

Thanks — that clarifies a lot. We will set the vendor to Redwood Inference UK Ltd (local entity needed for our EU legal / VAT handling). A couple follow-ups from our side: 

- Payment terms: our standard is Net45 but we can do Net30 for strategic vendors. What are Redwood's standard payment terms for hosted inference?
- PO split: we prefer one invoice per PO but will accept consolidated monthly invoices if Redwood includes the PO list in the invoice.
- Test integration: can your team drop a test invoice to our SFTP staging endpoint next Tuesday? We want to validate the parser against your PO_Mapping_Spec.

Attached our completed vendor form for the UK entity and a copy of the PO template we'll issue.

Regards,
Jorge

Hi Jorge — finalizing here and proposing a timeline so we can get the first PO through next week. Summary and confirmation below.

Confirmed items:
- Entity: Redwood Inference UK Ltd for FultonRail vendor profile (we will populate VAT number and company registration in the onboarding packet you upload).
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net30 on hosted API and usage invoicing. We can accept Net45 on a case-by-case exec-approved basis; if FultonRail prefers Net45, please confirm and mark the vendor profile accordingly.
- Invoice handling: Redwood will provide one invoice per PO by default. If you elect consolidated monthly billing, we will attach a cover page listing the included PO numbers and reference each PO on the line-items.
- VAT: For intra-EU services where reverse-charge applies, we will include the reverse-charge statement and our VAT number on the invoice. If FultonRail requires VAT to be charged, please attach the local VAT registration request and we can discuss exceptions with tax.
- Test drop: yes — we will place a sanitized test invoice on your SFTP staging endpoint Tuesday 2027-02-16 to validate mapping. Laura will own test execution.

Requested items from FultonRail:
- Upload FultonRail_VendorForm_20270204_Filled.pdf to your vendor portal and confirm vendor ID.
- Share staging SFTP host, username, and a single sample PO number to use during the test.
- Confirm whether AP will set vendor payment terms as Net30 or Net45 in the portal.

Attachments and links:
- DocuSign: W-8/W-9 or UK tax equivalent (we will send depending on entity) — https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&id=1234-ABCD
- HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/FR-2027-001

I'll schedule a 30-minute test call Monday to walk through the SFTP drop if that helps. Thanks again — cc'ing Hannah on tax/VAT questions and Laura on the SFTP/test plan.

Next steps / owners:
- Jorge/FultonRail: confirm vendor ID + staging SFTP creds by EOD Friday.
- Laura Bennett (Redwood): schedule SFTP drop and run mapping test (owner).
- Hannah Schmitt (Redwood): tax confirmation and DocuSign form issuance.

Best regards,
Irene
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
